stories.title: 1 dead, over 14 injured during stampede at TikToker's mehndi ceremony in Sialkot
summary: NAROWAL: A stampede at a mehndi (henna) ceremony and prize-distribution event for a TikTok influencer in Sialkot left one person dead and more than 14 others injured last night, officials said on Saturday.

The mehndi ceremony and prize-distribution event for Muhammad Ansar Jatt, a popular TikToker from Sialkot district known as “Mr Pattlo”, was scheduled for Saturday night at Faraz Cricket Ground on Daska Road.

However, Sialkot residents Muhammad Asif and Aamir Ali stated that more than 40 people were injured in the stampede, explaining that before the rescue teams arrived, attendees had taken several injured to nearby private hospitals and clinics for first aid on their own.

stories.title: Show HN: Jointter – A daily word puzzle using dots and lines
summary: This "alphabet" is always displayed below the game board, so the player can see the letters.The goal of the game is simple: you are presented with three rows of dots and a set of lines, and you have to figure out the word.
A great feature of the game is that it’s possible to deduce the word in a single turn — all the necessary information is right there on the board, allowing you to arrive at the answer with certainty.
So, I came up with a different solution: adding red dots for dots that aren't part of the target word.Another drawback is that the game is somewhat skewed.

stories.title: ECP notifies delimitation schedule for Quetta, Kharian cantonment boards after reclassification
summary: ISLAMABAD: The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) has notified delimitation schedules for the Quetta and Kharian cantonment boards following their reclassification by the federal government.

The ECP has appointed the Gujrat district election commissioner as the convener of the delimitation committee for Kharian, with the Kharian cantonment executive officer and Gujrat assistant election commissioner as members.
The regional election commissioners for Gujranwala and Quetta have been appointed as delimitation authorities for the Kharian and Quetta cantonment boards, respectively, to decide objections.
